help:
# HELP: Mangled single solve: 16/17 accepted, `cpp_format` open

All fields except `cpp_format` are GM-accepted (see confirmed.json); the solver reproduces them (`hctf solver-test` ok).

`cpp_format` (day02-cpp.elf, "exact artifact-derived value", "none only when absent") rejected so far:
`ELF`, `ELF64`, `HCFG`, `elf64-x86-64`. Five incorrect submissions in this attempt (one was a batch with a mutex quoting bug),
so the local cap is past; I stopped probing.

Facts: the C++ build is an ELF64 x86-64 EXEC (not PE, despite the prompt), its config is the `.hcfg` blob
(`HCFG` v1, xor 0x31, CRC32 header) holding JSON with keys campaign, domain, ipv4, url, mutex, windows_path,
linux_path, service, host_model (no "format" key). The binary prints a JSON trace
(schema `huntress.binary.dynamic_trace.v1`) with no format field either.

Untried candidates, roughly by likelihood: `json` (the config payload format), `ELF 64-bit LSB executable` (`file`),
`elf` (lowercase), `PE32+`/`PE` (if the generator labels the "Windows" C++ build by its intended format).
A human (or the Time Trial fixer, if a variant reveals the vocabulary) should decide; then add the mapping to
`FORMAT_NAMES` in solver/solve.py (keyed by (kind, bits), e.g. ("ELF", 64)).
